observation.visible_scene: A single flame glowing against a uniform black background. The flame has a rounded, bulbous base sitting in the lower-left-center of the frame and a tapering, brightly lit tongue that leans diagonally toward the upper-right. The interior core reads yellow-white while the outer edges are orange, and the whole form is soft-edged and slightly blurred.
visible_changes: The flame's base bulb remains anchored in roughly the same image position (lower-left-center) throughout the excerpt, with only minor changes in its width and outline.

The upper tip of the tongue moves vertically: it starts a bit lower in the frame (frames 1-2), lengthens upward so the tip approaches or touches the top edge (frames 3-11), then pulls back to a shorter, rounded tip that stays near the upper-right for the remainder of the clip (frames 12-41).
The tongue's tilt angle and curvature flicker subtly frame to frame, sometimes leaning more steeply, sometimes bowing, with the bright core shifting within the outline.

Brightness and shape of the flame deform continuously (flickering): the glowing region widens and narrows and the tip alternates between pointed and rounded, but the flame never goes out or changes color.
No object enters or leaves the frame; the only visible entity is the flame itself.
outside_clip_unknowns: The fuel source, wick, or mechanism producing the flame is not shown.
Whether the flame was just lit or has been burning before frame 1, and what happens after frame 41, is unknown; the excerpt shows an already ongoing burn with no onset or completion.
The cause of the flickering (airflow, fuel variation, etc.) is not visible.
uncertain_details: Camera motion cannot be determined because the background is featureless black; the stable position of the flame base suggests little or no camera movement, but this is not confirmed.
Whether the tip briefly reaching the top edge (frames 3-11) is the flame genuinely extending out of frame or just a framing artifact is unclear.
